manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes english-hub with tap-to-translate, XP/leagues/badges, the goal date plan, the grammar handbook, certificates and the Telegram quiz toggle. Until hub is deployed the new panels show their error/empty states.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus the five 20261024120000-20261024124000 English migrations, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds service-role-only tables english_word_glosses, english_league_groups, english_league_members, learner_badges, learner_review_answer_log, english_telegram_quiz_questions, english_certificates (RLS on, no client grants) and Russian/Uzbek handbook explanations on the 43 grammar units.

Secrets: supabase secrets set ENGLISH_AI_DAILY_LIMIT=, supabase secrets set ENGLISH_APP_URL= and supabase secrets set TELEGRAM_INTERNAL_SECRET= are not run: the first two keep their code defaults, and TELEGRAM_INTERNAL_SECRET is already configured for send-telegram and the schood-bot Worker; hub now reads it to authenticate the bot's enq: quiz callbacks.
Edge: supabase functions deploy hub --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel after the migrations (/word, /xp, /league, /achievements, /goal, /certificate(s), public certificate, /internal/telegram-quiz).
Edge: supabase functions deploy grammar-remediation --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel (GET /handbook).

Worker: cd workers/schood-bot && npx wrangler deploy, after hub is live. The bot only adds handling for callback data starting with enq: and reuses its existing TELEGRAM_INTERNAL_SECRET; everything else is unchanged.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows the five migrations applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.

Without a session GET /functions/v1/hub/word, /hub/xp, /hub/league, /hub/goal, /hub/certificates and GET /grammar-remediation/handbook return 401; POST /hub/internal/telegram-quiz without the worker secret returns 401; GET /hub/public/certificate/UNKNOWN returns 404.
As a learner: tapping a word in a reading article opens its meaning; finishing an activity shows +XP and the league page lists the learner; Settings shows Goal date and the Telegram quiz toggle.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-english to the previous deployment.
rollback.migration: Additive tables and metadata keys; leave in place.
rollback.edge: Redeploy hub and grammar-remediation from the previous main commit; the new routes stop, existing routes are unchanged.
rollback.worker: npx wrangler rollback in workers/schood-bot; enq: callbacks then go unanswered, nothing else changes.
